first.rationale: Competitor entry pricing makes targeted SMB pricing the most immediate acquisition defense, but its claimed revenue lift must be checked for retention, discount dependence, and qualification quality. Onboarding is also verified because completion is currently declining and it is a plausible competing revenue lever; the available summaries do not establish its relative long-term qualified-revenue impact. Use a tightly targeted, guarded experiment pending source review.

final.rationale: Run a shortened-onboarding experiment. It directly addresses falling completion and has verified evidence of higher completion, faster time-to-value, and improved 30-day retention, making it the strongest available sustainable-growth lever. Do not use promotional pricing: its verified retention decline makes its acquisition lift unlikely to produce durable qualified revenue. Monitor qualified conversion and longer-horizon retention because the onboarding evidence does not directly establish long-term revenue impact.
